question: On which days should one be restrained and conquer Shiva?
premises: The verse names the seventh day.
It names the great eighth day and conquering Shiva.
inference: Restraint on the seventh and conquest of Shiva on the great eighth are prescribed.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action on each day is abbreviated.
plain_english: Having become restrained on the seventh, one conquers Shiva on the great eighth.
